ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Peter colours in each of the eight circles in one of the colours red, yellow or blue. Two circles that are directly connected by a line, are not allowed to be of the same colour. Which two circles does Peter definitely have to colour in the same colour?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are 8 numbered circles in the figure. It can be seen that circle 2 is connected by lines to both circles 5 and 6, and circle 5 is also connected by a line to circle 6, so 2, 5, and 6 form a triangle. It can also be seen that circle 8 is connected to circle 2 by a diagonal line and to circle 6 by a horizontal line; circle 8 is not directly connected to circle 5. Reasoning: The problem stipulates that there are only three colors, red, yellow, and blue, and two directly connected circles cannot have the same color. Because 2, 5, and 6 form a triangle, they are connected pairwise, so these three circles must respectively use three different colors. That is to say, circle 2 and circle 6 have already occupied two different colors, while circle 5 uses the remaining third color. Circle 8 is connected to both circle 2 and circle 6, so circle 8 cannot use the color of circle 2 or circle 6, and can only use the remaining third color. This third color is exactly the color of circle 5. Therefore circle 5 and circle 8 must have the same color.

raw_record.question_text: Peter colours in each of the eight circles in one of the colours red, yellow or blue. Two circles that are directly connected by a line are not allowed to be of the same colour. Which two circles does Peter definitely have to colour in the same colour?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram as a graph: circles 2, 5, and 6 form a triangle because each pair among them is directly connected; circle 8 is directly connected to circles 2 and 6, but not to circle 5. From the text, only three colours are available and adjacent circles must have different colours. Since the triangle 2-5-6 must use all three colours, circles 2 and 6 already use two different colours and circle 5 uses the remaining third colour. Circle 8 is connected to both 2 and 6, so it cannot use either of their colours; therefore it must use the remaining third colour, the same as circle 5. Conclude that circles 5 and 8 definitely have the same colour.

推理：题目规定只有红、黄、蓝三种颜色，并且直接相连的两个圆圈不能同色。因为 2、5、6 构成三角形，它们两两相连，所以这三个圆圈必须分别使用三种不同颜色。也就是说，圆圈 2 和圆圈 6 已经占用了两种不同颜色，而圆圈 5 使用剩下的第三种颜色。圆圈 8 同时与圆圈 2 和圆圈 6 相连，因此圆圈 8 不能使用圆圈 2 或圆圈 6 的颜色，只能使用剩下的第三种颜色。这个第三种颜色正是圆圈 5 的颜色。因此圆圈 5 和圆圈 8 一定同色。
